en: {spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Oh, no need to thank me. When someone's in trouble, of course we help each other.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes... I'm relieved to hear you say that.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}...More importantly, Tia-san. Will you keep on acting as a hero from now on?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Huh? ...Y-yes. That's what I intend to do...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}I see. I'm glad.{n}{wait}{clear}Please tell the Angel that too. I'm sure it will make the Angel happy.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Y-yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Well then. It's hard for both of us, but let's keep doing our best.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Um... You're Dian-sama, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Hm? And you're Tia-san, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes, that's right. Thank you for saving me the other day.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}There's no need for thanks. I only did what I should.{n}{wait}{clear}...More importantly, how are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Oh, I'm sorry. I'm fine now, thanks to you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}I see. Whenever you feel unwell, please come to me.{n}{wait}{clear}I may not look it, but I am a doctor.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes. Thank you very much. I'll do that when the time comes.{n}{wait}{clear}Well, that's all for today... Oh, um, please keep up the good work.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Yes, you too. And please be careful not to push yourself.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Um, Yaruru-kun?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Huh? Oh, it's you, big sis!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Thank you for saving me the other day.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Aw, you're making me blush. I only did what anybody would.{n}{wait}{clear}But are you okay? You went through something really awful, didn't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}No, I'm fine. I'm completely well again now. Thank you, really.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Okay. That's good, then! Hehe.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Being a hero is hard work, but keep doing your best, Yaruru-kun.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Okay! You too, big sis!!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Um... are you Ryudral-sama?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Hm? Oh, your name was Tia, wasn't it...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes, I'm Tia Tangeri. Thank you for saving me the other day.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Hey, you don't need to thank me. I only did what anyone would.{n}{wait}{clear}...More importantly, are you all right? Your body and everything?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes. Thanks to you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}I see... Good.{n}{wait}{clear}When you're a hero, all sorts of things happen to you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Well...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}But don't push yourself too hard, okay? After all, you're... um... a girl and all...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes. Please take care too, Ryudral-sama.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Yeah, you too. See you!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Um, are you Fiana-sama?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Hm? You're the girl from the other day...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes, I'm Tia Tangeri. Thank you so much for saving me the other day.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Oh, that's nothing. Besides, if you want to thank someone, thank the Angel. The Angel seemed really worried.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Y-yes... I'm sorry...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}So, are you all right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes. Thanks to you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Good. ...But you'd better not push yourself too hard.{n}{wait}{clear}Help won't always come, you know. Well, really, take care.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Y-yes!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Um... are you Ashe-sama?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Huh? Oh, you're Tia-san, if I remember right.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes, that's right.{n}{wait}{clear}Thank you so much for saving me the other day.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}What are you saying? That's nothing. Don't worry about it.{n}{wait}{clear}We're both heroes, and both women too, right? Of course I'd help!{n}{wait}{clear}Besides, it could be me tomorrow. Let's keep helping each other from now on!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes. Thank you very much. Um... please keep doing your best.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}You too!{n}{wait}{clear}The world is crawling with enemies of maidens, so be careful!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Well, see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Um... are you Beasia-san?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Hm? You're, uh, Tia... right?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes.{n}{wait}{clear}Thank you for saving me the other day.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Aw, come on, don't worry about it. I didn't do much anyway.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}No, really, thank you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Enough already. But... more importantly, you really are a hero too?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes. I am... Why?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}N-no reason... I see. You sure don't look strong, though.{n}{wait}{clear}But that angel picked you, so there must be something to you, I bet.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Um...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Anyway, don't push yourself too hard! This world is full of tough guys.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes... I'll do my very best not to hold anyone back.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Yeah. Whatever you do, don't do anything reckless.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Well, excuse me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Jeez... Is that girl really a hero?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Nasadia-sama... Is that you, Nasadia-sama?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}...Oh my. You're the girl from the other day...{n}{wait}{clear}Tia-san, wasn't it...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes, that's right. Thank you so much for saving me the other day.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}So you remembered me.{n}{wait}{clear}But... there's really nothing to worry about. I only did what anyone would.{n}{wait}{clear}Besides, if you want to thank someone, thank that Angel of ours.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes... But you did save me. Someday I'll repay you, I promise...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Heh heh. You're still young. I don't think you need to worry so much.{n}{wait}{clear}While you're young, it's fine to lean on people. Loosen up a little, okay?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Y-yes... But...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Never mind, just don't worry about it. Bye now. If we meet again, let's have some tea.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What can I do for you, Beasia?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}Nothing. I just had some free time, so I thought I'd call you and let you hang out with me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Is that kind of thing a bother after all?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛No, call me anytime.　　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Call me if I'm needed.　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛For you, I'll gladly come.｝{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah? But when you say it so plainly, it's actually harder to call you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well, if I'm honest, I'm glad. Okay, got it. I'll do that.{n}{fd:0A8000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You're an angel, but you're weirdly humble. If you act like that all the time, humans will walk all over you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You seem more trustworthy than I first thought, so I think you can hold your head higher.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Yeah? When you put it like that, it's kind of embarrassing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Anyway, for you I feel like I'd do all sorts of things, so come see me whenever you feel like it.{n}{fd:0A8000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}Oh, you came. That was fast.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you need, Beasia?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Say. What do you usually do all day? You don't look like you move around much. I called you because I think you should exercise.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛I see... Thank you.　　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I do train. I'm fine.　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Then I'll try to exercise.｝{n}{end}
{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛I see... Thank you.　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I do train. I'm fine.｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I'll try to exercise.｝{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}You don't have to thank me or anything. Looks like I called you out when you were busy...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...It's just, unless you make up your own mind to do it, you'll never exercise. You should take care of your body, okay?{n}{fd:0A8000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}......Don't lie to me. I can tell whether someone trains just by looking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You don't seem like the fighting type, so I won't say much, but I don't think lying is good.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}That's it. What, you get it after all. ...You've got more guts than you look.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Every dojo out there cares only about form. Nobody gets the attitude right first. Hold on to that spirit, okay?{n}{fd:0A8000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}Great. You came!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Yes... What do you need, Beasia?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}Need...? Well... I just wanted to talk with you, that's all. Don't you ever feel that way?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛Of course. It's fun.　　　　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I don't have time for it now.｝{n}{f7:0080}｛I always want to see you.　　｝{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}R-really?! ...N-no, that's all I needed to hear.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Huh. I see... All right! I'll try even harder! Come and see me again, okay?!{n}{fd:0A8000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I see... So that's how it is... You always do look busy.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Which means I still need a lot more training... Right! Sorry for calling you out! See you!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Huh, wh-what? Really? You want to see me that much?!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Th-then I'll call you again! Come next time too, okay! Yeah. That's enough for today! See you!{n}{fd:0A8000800580}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{n}Oh, you came.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What is it, Beasia?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{n}I thought I'd give you this.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}A {name:0280}?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. You've done a lot for me, after all. How about it? You'll take it, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}｛I'll gladly accept.　　｝{n}{f7:0080}｛Since you offer, thanks.｝{n}{f7:0080}｛My vows forbid it.　　　｝{n}{end}

{fb:2C81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0580}{n}......I see.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Even something like that is forbidden? Angels sure aren't free to do much. Fine. I'll take this back home.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...? Was it something you didn't like? If you don't want it, I'll find something else.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Eh, whatever. Anyway, I'm counting on you from now on.{n}{fd:0A8000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
